title: 第2778章 生死奥义第2777章 争夺天尊传承
content_zh:
伴随着时间的推移，众人对于奥义神座的争夺自然越发地激烈起来。
毕竟涉及到了天尊传承，根本无人能做得到真正的坐视不理。
在这期间，秦玄先后两次冲上了奥义神座上，以绝对实力顶着最为可怕的斥力坐下来。
坐下来的刹那，自然也得到了生死天尊的天尊传承。
天尊传承降临的刹那，毫无疑问，他便得到了至高无上的生死至尊天道的感悟，蕴含着不仅仅是浩瀚如烟的生死神道，更是涉及到神王神尊层次的生死奥义，乃至更高层次的生死秩序。
生死秩序，乃是天道秩序。
属于大道的最根本本源。
只要掌握了天道秩序，便可真正地领悟完整的生死天道。
只要领悟了完整的生死天道，便可直接成就至尊！
不过，想要一边接受天尊传承，感悟至尊天道与秩序，一边承受奥义神座上的无穷斥力，一边抵挡各方攻击……
毫无疑问，是不太现实的事情。
轰轰轰轰轰轰——
仅仅只是坐上去奥义神座上短短二十息不到，秦玄便被各方强者的攻击所落下，直接皮开肉绽，露出了最为坚硬的神骨。
神骨哪怕比起寻常神兵还要坚硬得多，依旧也出现了密密麻麻的裂痕。
可想而知，各方攻击是多么地可怕。
因为，可不只是只有古路众多试炼天骄，还有多位古路附近星域的顶尖神灵，其中甚至有星宿境中后期的顶尖神灵。
秦玄被轰下来了，浑身是血，跌落在神座旁。
不过很快，他不惜自损本源，施展混沌不灭术，瞬间修复伤势，再度坐上去了。
再度接受天尊传承，感悟那至高无上的天道秩序。
本来，秦玄在生死城主体内神王界中，感受着两大生死神王的生死大战，更是亲身感应到生死城主从生死两分突破到生死之间层次，便收获匪浅。

如今借助天尊传承中的生死天道，可谓是更进一步。
逐渐地领悟出了一丝微乎其微的生命奥义，以及死亡奥义。
奥义，涉及到神王层次的领域。
说明，秦玄已经能窥探到通往生命神王、死亡神王的领域。
更为惊人的是，凭借着领悟出的一丝微乎其微的生命奥义，以及死亡奥义，凭借着一丝微乎其微的混沌奥义的作用下，一道通万道通，从而从而逐渐地作用在阴五行之上。
本来，秦玄的阴五行大道，只差一步便可成就神道了。
如今，神道壁障就在眼前。
只要再给秦玄片刻钟时间，凭借感悟出的生死奥义，反哺于阴五行大道上，便足以助之突破成为神道。
秦玄自然不会轻易放弃。
可根本不行。
轰轰轰轰轰——
一连串的攻击下。
秦玄再度被轰得几乎粉身碎骨，跌落下奥义神座下。
唰！
趁此机会，天运星主闪电般地冲上去，强行抵挡住斥力，坐下去。
天尊传承之光降临。
当然，也仅仅只能坐下十三息时间，便被轰下去了。
猿魔真神紧随其后，凭借积淀深厚的神道修为，硬抗神座自带的排斥之力，短暂地承接天尊传承。
幽渊古神也趁机抢占片刻机缘，借助天尊传承之力，让一身修为稳步精进……
content_en:
As time goes by, the competition for the Mysterious God Seat naturally becomes more and more intense.
After all, it involves the inheritance of Tianzun, and no one can really sit back and watch.
During this period, Qin Xuan rushed to the throne of the Mysterious God twice, and sat down with absolute strength against the most terrifying repulsion.
The moment he sat down, he naturally received the inheritance of the Heavenly Lord of Life and Death.
The moment the Tianzun inheritance came, there was no doubt that he had gained the enlightenment of the supreme heavenly way of life and death, which contained not only the vast and vast divine way of life and death, but also the profound meaning of life and death at the level of the god king and god, and even the order of life and death at a higher level.
The order of life and death is the order of heaven.
It belongs to the most fundamental origin of Dao.
As long as you master the order of heaven, you can truly understand the complete heavenly law of life and death.
As long as you understand the complete way of life and death, you can directly achieve supreme status!
However, if you want to accept the inheritance of the Heavenly Lord and understand the supreme way of heaven and order, while enduring the infinite repulsive force on the Mysterious God's throne, while resisting attacks from all sides...
There is no doubt that it is unrealistic.
Boom boom boom boom boom——
Just after sitting on the seat of the Mysterious God for less than twenty breaths, Qin Xuan was attacked by strong men from all sides, and his skin and flesh were torn open, revealing the hardest divine bones.
Even though the divine bones were much harder than ordinary divine weapons, there were still dense cracks.
It is conceivable how terrible the attacks from all sides are.
Because, there are not only the many trial geniuses in the ancient road, but also many top gods in the star fields near the ancient road, including even top gods in the middle and late stages of the star realm.
Qin Xuan was knocked down, covered in blood, and fell next to the throne.
But soon, he did not hesitate to damage his own strength and used the Chaos Immortality Technique to instantly repair his injuries and sit on it again.
Accept the inheritance of Tianzun again and understand the supreme order of heaven.
Originally, Qin Xuan experienced the life-and-death battle between the two god-kings of life and death in the inner God King Realm of the City of Life and Death. He also personally sensed the city lord of Life and Death's breakthrough from life and death to the level between life and death, and gained a lot.
Now with the help of the heavenly law of life and death in Tianzun's inheritance, it can be said that we have gone a step further.
Gradually, I realized a tiny bit of the secret of life and the secret of death.
Mysteries involve the realm of the God-King level.
This shows that Qin Xuan has been able to spy on the realm leading to the God King of Life and the God King of Death.
What is even more astonishing is that with the help of a tiny bit of the Mystery of Life and the Mystery of Death, and with the help of a tiny bit of the Mystery of Chaos, one path leads to all paths, and thus gradually affects the Five Elements of Yin.
Originally, Qin Xuan's Yin Five Elements Dao was only one step away from becoming a divine Dao.
Now, the Shinto barrier is right in front of us.
As long as Qin Xuan is given a few more minutes to rely on the profound meaning of life and death he has comprehended and feed it back on the Yin Five Elements Avenue, it will be enough to help him break through and become a divine way.
Naturally, Qin Xuan would not give up easily.
But that doesn't work at all.
Boom boom boom boom——
Under a series of attacks.
Qin Xuan was blasted to pieces again and fell down from the seat of the Mysterious God.
Uh-huh!
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Lord Tianyun rushed forward like lightning, resisted the repulsive force, and sat down.
The light of Tianzun's inheritance comes.
Of course, he could only sit down for thirteen breaths before he was knocked down.
The True God of the Ape Demon followed closely behind, relying on his profound spiritual cultivation to resist the repulsive power of the divine throne, and briefly inherited the inheritance of the Heavenly Lord.
Ancient God Youyuan also took the opportunity to seize a moment of opportunity and relied on the power of Tianzun's inheritance to steadily improve his cultivation...
